mapper.insert: INSERT INTO watch_history (user_id, video_id, watch_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{videoId}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE watch_time = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM watch_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND video_id = #{videoId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM watch_history WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT wh.* FROM watch_history wh JOIN video_info v ON wh.video_id = v.video_id WHERE wh.user_id = #{userId} AND v.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY wh.watch_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
